title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 5,101–5,150 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 全民智慧醫療體系；醫療保健

examples.en: Taiwan's universal healthcare system is globally acclaimed for its exceptional efficiency, accessibility, and quality.
examples.zh: 台灣全民健康保險智慧醫療體系以其卓越的覆蓋率、極佳便利性與高水準醫療品質享譽全球。

examples.en: Investing in preventative healthcare reduces long-term hospitalization costs across aging societies.
examples.zh: 大力投資發展預防醫學與基層健康保健，能顯著降低高齡化社會長期的公立醫院住院醫療支出。

examples.en: Dedicated healthcare workers sacrificed family time during the pandemic to staff quarantine wards.
examples.zh: 滿懷崇高使命感的第一線醫事與醫療保健工作人員，在疫情肆虐期間犧牲天倫之樂日夜留守隔離病房。

words.definition: 全民健康保險 (NHI)；保險

examples.en: The National Health Insurance (NHI) MediCloud app allows citizens to view their prescription records securely.
examples.zh: 全民健保快易通 App 讓全體國人隨時透過手機安全查閱個人就醫用藥紀錄與檢驗報告。

examples.en: New vehicle owners purchase comprehensive collision insurance to protect against unexpected traffic accidents.
examples.zh: 新車車主牽車時通常會主動投保丙式或乙式車體車輛碰撞損失保險，全面防範突發行車擦撞意外。

examples.en: Premium health insurance covers private hospital suites, specialized immunotherapy, and advanced surgery.
examples.zh: 頂級商業醫療健康保險能全額給付單人豪華病房差額、自費高階免疫標靶藥物與微創手術耗材。

words.definition: 達文西微創手術 (da Vinci)；外科手術

examples.en: Surgeons perform complex robotic-assisted surgery with millimeter-level precision using the da Vinci Xi system.
examples.zh: 外科主治醫師操作第四代達文西手術機器人，以毫米級的極致精準度執行高難度微創腫瘤切除手術。

examples.en: After three hours in exploratory surgery, the team successfully removed the patient's inflamed appendix.
examples.zh: 歷經整整三個小時的腹腔鏡探查外科手術，外科醫療團隊順利為急性闌尾炎患者切除發炎腫脹的闌尾。

examples.en: Plastic surgery reconstructs facial bones following severe automobile collisions, restoring function and appearance.
examples.zh: 重建整型外科權威大師針對嚴重重大車禍傷患執行顱顏骨折重建手術，悉心重建患者咀嚼機能與容貌尊嚴。

words.definition: 微創手術的；侵入性的

examples.en: Minimally invasive surgery reduces patient trauma, causing significantly less pain and smaller scars.
examples.zh: 微創手術（Minimally Invasive Surgery）大幅降低了人體組織創傷，帶來傷口微小、疼痛少且出血量極低的優點。

examples.en: Non-invasive blood pressure monitors wrap comfortably around the arm without piercing blood vessels.
examples.zh: 家用非侵入性全自動電子血壓計僅需舒適包裹手臂即可量測，完全無需穿刺血管造成任何疼痛。

examples.en: Aggressive invasive plant species spread rapidly along wetlands, suffocating native water lilies.
examples.zh: 繁衍能力極為強勢的外來入侵種水生植物在濕地迅速蔓延擴散，重重擠壓並窒息了本土原生睡蓮的生長。

words.definition: 多關節機械手臂的；機器人的

examples.en: Multi-jointed robotic arms bend and rotate beyond the natural limits of human hands inside tight pelvic cavities.
examples.zh: 靈活的七軸多關節機械手臂能在狹窄深邃的人體骨盆腔深處，完成超越真人手腕極限的精準旋轉角度。

examples.en: The automated pharmaceutical warehouse uses robotic carts to sort prescriptions around the clock.
examples.zh: 現代化智慧醫藥自動化倉儲全面引進多關節無人搬運機器人，全天候二十四小時精準分揀病患處方藥品。

examples.en: His dry, robotic speech tone made it difficult for colleagues to connect with him emotionally.
examples.zh: 他在公務簡報時那種缺乏起伏、如同背書般機械式的僵硬語調，讓台下跨部門同事難以產生情感共鳴。

words.definition: 消除手部微顫震動；微震

examples.en: Advanced tremor filtration software smooths out natural hand tremors during delicate microscopic suturing.
examples.zh: 精密的手震過濾軟體能自動消除醫師手部的微小顫抖，在微血管精密縫合時維持絕對平穩。

examples.en: Neurologists evaluate resting hand tremors as an early diagnostic marker for Parkinson's disease.
examples.zh: 神經內科主治醫師將靜止性手部微小顫抖（Tremor），視為診斷評估早期帕金森氏症的重要臨床指標。

examples.en: A minor seismic tremor rattled apartment windows across Hualien, but caused zero structural damage.
examples.zh: 一陣芮氏規模四級的輕微有感地震搖晃了花蓮沿海民宅玻璃窗，所幸並未造成任何建築結構損害。

words.definition: 主刀醫師遠端操作控制台；控制台

examples.en: Sitting comfortably at the ergonomic console, the surgeon views high-definition 3D magnified anatomical structures.
examples.zh: 主刀醫師端坐於符合人體工學的控制台（Console）前，透過 3D 高畫質放大目鏡清晰透視體內微細解剖構造。

examples.en: Teenagers connected their favorite gaming console to the living room television for a weekend tournament.
examples.zh: 國高中青年在週末將最新款次世代家庭電視遊戲主機連接至客廳大螢幕，與好友熱血展開雙打電競對決。

examples.en: She struggled to console her weeping best friend after the sudden passing of her golden retriever.
examples.zh: 面對陪伴十年的愛犬黃金獵犬突然安詳離世，她坐在沙發旁溫柔擁抱並竭盡全力撫慰（Console）泣不成聲的摯友。

words.definition: 高畫質內視鏡；腹腔鏡 (Endoscope)

examples.en: A high-definition 4K endoscope provides bright illumination and crystal-clear visualization inside organs.
examples.zh: 導入 4K 超高畫質螢光內視鏡（Endoscope），為體內器官深處提供明亮無死角的清晰導航視野。

examples.en: The gastroenterologist passed a thin, flexible endoscope down the esophagus to inspect stomach ulcers.
examples.zh: 腸胃肝膽科主任輕柔引導一根超細纖維可彎曲無痛胃鏡內視鏡深入食道，仔細檢視十二指腸與胃潰瘍病灶。

examples.en: Technicians sterilize the endoscope between procedures adhering to rigid decontamination protocols.
examples.zh: 醫學中心內視鏡檢查室技術人員嚴格遵循高層次消毒滅菌規範，在每位病患檢查之間將內視鏡徹底滅菌。

words.definition: 鑰匙孔微創小切口 (Keyhole)；切口

examples.en: Three 1-centimeter keyhole incisions replace the traditional 20-centimeter open abdominal wound.
examples.zh: 僅需開三個一公分大小的「鑰匙孔」微創切口（Incision），即可完全取代傳統二十公分的開腹大傷口。

examples.en: The surgical team closed the clean scalp incision with absorbable surgical sutures and waterproof dressings.
examples.zh: 手術室醫療團隊以可吸收式外科縫合線與防水敷料，工整細緻地縫合病患頭皮微創手術切口。

examples.en: Nurses instructed the patient to keep the abdominal incision dry and clean to prevent bacterial infection.
examples.zh: 病房照護護理師出院衛教時細心叮嚀病患，務必保持腹部微創切口傷口乾燥清潔，嚴防汗水引發細菌感染。

words.definition: 術中極小化失血量；流血

examples.en: Electrocautery sealing tools minimize intraoperative bleeding, eliminating the need for blood transfusions.
examples.zh: 運用高頻電燒止血刀能將手術中失血量（Bleeding）壓至最低，讓絕大多數患者免於術中額外輸血。

examples.en: Apply firm, direct pressure with a sterile gauze pad to stop minor finger bleeding from a kitchen cut.
examples.zh: 在廚房切菜不慎切傷手指時，第一時間拿起無菌紗布墊用力直接加壓傷口五分鐘以迅速止血。

examples.en: Emergency doctors administered coagulation factors to reverse internal bleeding caused by blood thinners.
examples.zh: 急診創傷團隊火速施打專用凝血因子拮抗劑，緊急逆轉這名因長期服用抗凝血劑引發的突發性體內出血。

words.definition: 術後加速康復療程 (ERAS)；康復

examples.en: Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocols help elderly patients walk comfortably on day one.
examples.zh: 導入「怡樂適術後加速康復療程」（ERAS），能幫助高齡長輩在手術當天即可舒適下床走動。

examples.en: The national airline celebrated a strong financial recovery as international business travel rebounded.
examples.zh: 隨著全球國際商務差旅市場強勁復甦反彈，國籍旗艦航空公司的客運營收迎來了令人振奮的獲利大復甦。

examples.en: Physical therapy and acupuncture significantly accelerated the injured basketball player's knee recovery.
examples.zh: 結合現代運動醫學物理治療與傳統中醫針灸通絡，顯著加速了這位受傷職籃射手十字韌帶術後的康復進度。

words.definition: 康復出院；排出；釋放

examples.en: Patients receiving robotic prostatectomy celebrate safe hospital discharge within forty-eight hours.
examples.zh: 接受達文西攝護腺微創手術的患者，在術後短短四十八小時之內即可健康平安辦理出院手續（Discharge）。

examples.en: Environmental inspectors fined the textile factory for illegally discharging untreated dye water into the river.
examples.zh: 環保局稽查大隊當場抓包某不肖染整工廠利用暗管將未經處理的強鹼印染廢水偷排至溪流，依法重罰停工。

examples.en: The soldier received an honorable military discharge after completing twenty years of loyal service.
examples.zh: 在恪盡職守為國效力滿整整二十年軍旅歲月後，這位資深士官長光榮獲頒退役證明書與榮譽榮民證。

words.definition: AI 輔助醫療影像判讀；成像

examples.en: Deep learning medical imaging algorithms assist radiologists in detecting hairline bone fractures in seconds.
examples.zh: 深度學習醫療影像判讀演算法（Imaging AI），能在數秒內協助放射科醫師揪出隱蔽的微細骨裂。

examples.en: Satellite optical imaging allows disaster relief commanders to map landslide damage across mountain highways.
examples.zh: 高解析度人造衛星光學空拍影像，讓防災應變指揮中心能第一時間精準標定山區省道土石流阻斷災情。

examples.en: Thermal imaging cameras deployed at international arrival terminals screen passengers for fever in real time.
examples.zh: 國際機場入境海關通道設置的紅外線熱顯像儀，全天候即時監控並自動篩檢每一位入境旅客的體溫。

words.definition: 數位 X 光放射線攝影；X光照相術

examples.en: Digital chest radiography provides instant high-contrast scans stored directly onto hospital PACS servers.
examples.zh: 數位胸部 X 光放射攝影（Radiography）提供即時高對比影像，並自動歸檔至全院醫療影像儲傳系統。

examples.en: Industrial radiography utilizes gamma-ray sources to inspect internal weld seams inside pressurized pipelines.
examples.zh: 工業用射線檢測照相術利用伽馬射線放射源，無損穿透並檢測高壓天然氣輸送管線內部的金屬焊接接縫。

examples.en: Radiologic technologists guide patients through correct breathing postures during digital lumbar radiography.
examples.zh: 醫事放射師在進行數位腰椎 X 光照射時，溫柔引導病患調整最佳擺位並配合呼吸吸氣閉氣指令。

words.definition: 磁振造影檢查 (MRI)；共振

examples.en: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans soft brain tissues without exposing patients to ionizing radiation.
examples.zh: 磁振造影（MRI）在完全零游離輻射的環境下，能高解析度清晰掃描大腦神經與軟組織病變。

examples.en: Her impassioned commencement speech about social equity achieved immense emotional resonance with graduates.
examples.zh: 她在全校畢業典禮上關於社會公平與弱勢關懷的真情演說，在全體畢業生心中激起了巨大的情感共鳴。

examples.en: Structural engineers tuned the suspension bridge dampeners to counteract destructive aerodynamic wind resonance.
examples.zh: 橋樑結構工程師精準調校長跨度懸索吊橋內部的阻尼抗風阻尼器，徹底消除強風引發的破壞性氣動共振現象。

words.definition: 掌上型手持式無線超音波 (POCUS)

examples.en: Pocket-sized handheld ultrasound probes allow emergency doctors to assess internal trauma right at the bedside.
examples.zh: 口袋大小的掌上型手持式無線超音波（Ultrasound），讓急診醫師能在病床旁一秒評估腹腔內出血。

examples.en: Expectant parents held hands and smiled with joy as the obstetrician shared live 4D fetus ultrasound images.
examples.zh: 滿懷期盼的準爸媽在婦產科診間緊緊牽著手，看著螢幕上婦產科主任分享的四維超音波胎兒即時動態微笑。

examples.en: Bats navigate pitch-black caves effortlessly by emitting and listening to ultrasonic pulses beyond human hearing.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠在伸手不見五指的幽暗洞穴中高速穿梭自如，全憑發射並接收人耳不可聽見的高頻超音波回聲定位。

words.definition: 低劑量電腦斷層 (LDCT) 肺部結節

examples.en: Low-Dose CT (LDCT) screening detects sub-centimeter ground-glass lung nodules at curable Stage 1.
examples.zh: 低劑量電腦斷層（LDCT）篩檢能在極早期揪出小於一公分的毛玻璃狀肺部微小結節（Nodule）。

examples.en: Nitrogen-fixing bacteria live symbiotically inside root nodules of soybean crops, enriching agricultural soil.
examples.zh: 具備固氮功能的根瘤菌與大豆根系上的根瘤組織共生共榮，為農田土壤自然補充純天然的氮素養分。

examples.en: The endocrinologist performed a fine-needle biopsy on the thyroid nodule to rule out malignancy.
examples.zh: 內分泌新陳代謝科醫師在超音波精準導引下，為這顆甲狀腺結節進行細針抽吸細胞學檢查以排除惡性腫瘤。

words.definition: 皮膚與黏膜可疑病灶病變；損傷

examples.en: Dermatologists use AI dermoscopy to analyze irregular pigmented skin lesions for melanoma signs.
examples.zh: 皮膚科醫師結合 AI 皮膚鏡影像演算法，精準比對不對稱色素病灶（Lesion）是否有黑色素瘤徵兆。

examples.en: Brain imaging revealed minor focal lesions resulting from a transient ischemic attack suffered last year.
examples.zh: 腦部高階磁振造影清晰顯示出數處因去年短暫性腦缺血發作（小中風）所留下的微小局部腦組織病灶損傷。

examples.en: Oral surgeons biopsied a persistent white lesion on the inside of the patient's cheek.
examples.zh: 口腔顎面外科醫師為病患口腔內側頰黏膜上久久未癒、形狀異常的白色斑塊病灶進行切片病理化驗。

words.definition: 急診智慧五級檢傷分類；分診

examples.en: Automated emergency triage systems prioritize chest pain patients showing early signs of heart attacks.
examples.zh: 智慧急診檢傷分類系統（Triage）會將出現急性心肌梗塞徵兆的胸痛急症病患自動列為最高優先搶救等級。

examples.en: During mass casualty transportation accidents, experienced triage nurses categorize injured victims within seconds.
examples.zh: 在重大集體交通事故現場，資深急診護理師依據檢傷標準在數秒內迅速為傷患繫上紅黃綠黑檢傷分類手環。

examples.en: The tech support manager had to triage incoming bug tickets during the critical holiday software rollout.
examples.zh: 在電商年終購物節旗艦版本軟體上線之際，資深資訊主管必須親自對雪片般湧入的系統通報進行緊急分級優先處理。

words.definition: 急性缺血性腦中風 (黃金搶救期)

examples.en: Rapid AI brain CT scans identify candidates for clot-busting stroke therapy within the golden 3-hour window.
examples.zh: AI 腦部電腦斷層能在黃金三小時關鍵窗口內，迅速篩選出適合施打血栓溶解劑的急性缺血性腦中風病患。

examples.en: Remembering the FAST acronym—Face, Arm, Speech, Time—saves lives when recognizing stroke symptoms.
examples.zh: 牢記辛辛那提腦中風評估口訣「微笑、舉手、說你好、快打119」，能在身旁親友中風發作時搶下救命先機。

examples.en: With a single masterful stroke of his calligraphy brush, the grandmaster finished the poetic couplet.
examples.zh: 書法國寶大師手握狼毫巨筆，氣定神閒運筆一揮，以一記遒勁有力的一筆一劃完成了氣勢磅礡的傳世對聯。

words.definition: 腦動脈瘤微創栓塞支架手術；動脈瘤

examples.en: Neurosurgeons deploy platinum micro-coils to treat unruptured intracranial aneurysms via groin arteries.
examples.zh: 神經外科醫師自患者鼠蹊部微創穿刺，將微型白金彈簧圈精準推入顱內未破裂動脈瘤（Aneurysm）進行栓塞。

examples.en: An unruptured brain aneurysm often causes zero warning symptoms until a severe, thunderclap headache strikes.
examples.zh: 顱內未破裂動脈瘤宛如體內不定時炸彈，平時往往毫無徵兆，直到破裂引發劇烈如雷劈般的爆炸性頭痛。

examples.en: Interventional radiologists placed a coated stent-graft to repair the patient's expanding abdominal aortic aneurysm.
examples.zh: 介入性放射科團隊透過微創血管內導管技術植入覆膜金屬支架，成功拆除了病患日漸擴大的腹主動脈瘤危機。

words.definition: 偏鄉視訊看診遠距醫療 (Telemedicine)

examples.en: High-speed 5G connectivity enables rural mountain clinics to conduct real-time telemedicine consultations with medical centers.
examples.zh: 藉由 5G 超高速網路，偏鄉原鄉衛生所能與醫學中心權威專科名醫即時連線視訊看診（Telemedicine）。

examples.en: The health ministry broadened telemedicine regulations to allow online prescription renewals for chronic patients.
examples.zh: 衛生福利部正式放寬遠距醫療法規限制，全面允許行動不便之慢性病穩定患者透過視訊門診開立慢籤與領藥。

examples.en: During periods of contagious viral outbreaks, telemedicine visits minimized virus transmission in crowded waiting rooms.
examples.zh: 在高傳染性呼吸道病毒流行期間，全面推展視訊門診有效避免了醫院門診候診大廳人潮聚集所造成的交叉感染。

words.definition: 遠端居家生理數據監測 (RPM) 的

examples.en: Remote patient monitoring devices transmit daily oxygen saturation and weight readings to cardiology nurses.
examples.zh: 遠端居家生理數據監測設備（RPM），每日定時將心臟衰竭病患的血氧與體重數據自動回傳給個管師。

examples.en: The tech startup adopted a permanent remote work policy, allowing developers to live anywhere in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這家軟體新創全面擁抱遠距彈性工作模式，允許軟體工程師自主選擇定居於花蓮或全台任何城市生活。

examples.en: Backpackers ventured into remote aboriginal mountain valleys far beyond cellular phone reception.
examples.zh: 冒險熱血的登山客背起重裝，深入完全遠離手機基地台通訊訊號覆蓋的深山原住民古老獵徑幽谷。

words.definition: 連續型血糖監測 (CGM) 穿戴裝置的

examples.en: Continuous glucose monitoring wearable sensors help diabetic patients track blood sugar spikes effortlessly.
examples.zh: 配戴在手臂上的連續型血糖監測（CGM）智慧穿戴貼片，能讓糖尿病患免除扎針煩惱、輕鬆掌握血糖波動。

examples.en: Smart wearable rings track sleep stages, body temperature variations, and cardiovascular recovery overnight.
examples.zh: 佩戴在手指上的高精度智慧穿戴健康戒，能在睡眠期間全程記錄快速動眼期、皮膚溫度微幅波動與心血管修復力。

examples.en: Advances in flexible battery technology promise lighter, skin-friendly wearable medical patches.
examples.zh: 柔性超薄固態電池化學材料的突破，為次世代更輕盈、更透氣親膚的醫用等級貼片穿戴裝置帶來了量產曙光。

words.definition: 醫療級無線心電圖連續生理遙測

examples.en: Continuous wireless ECG telemetry alerts ward doctors the moment dangerous arrhythmias occur.
examples.zh: 貼在胸口的醫療級無線心電圖遙測儀（Telemetry），能在心律不整發作的瞬間自動向護理站發出蜂鳴警報。

examples.en: Space agency controllers monitored the astronaut’s heart rate telemetry during the strenuous spacewalk.
examples.zh: 太空總署地面飛行控制中心醫療官，在太空人執行長達數小時艱鉅艙外太空漫步時全程緊盯即時心率遙測數據。

examples.en: Formula One engineers rely on telemetry sensors to diagnose tire degradation and engine pressure in real time.
examples.zh: 一級方程式賽車後勤工程團隊完全倚賴即時車況數據遙測技術，秒級診斷賽車熱熔胎磨損與引擎機油壓力變化。

words.definition: 手指夾式血氧飽和度濃度計 (SpO2)

examples.en: Fingertip pulse oximeters measure blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) and heart rate non-invasively.
examples.zh: 手指夾式脈搏血氧儀（Oximeter）能在短短數秒內，以完全無痛非侵入式方式測出血液含氧飽和度。

examples.en: When climbing high-altitude peaks like Yushan, hikers pack a lightweight oximeter to screen for hypoxia.
examples.zh: 在攀登玉山或雪山等三千公尺以上高山百岳時，登山隊伍必備輕巧的指夾式血氧機，隨時自我篩檢有無高山低血氧。

examples.en: Home care nurses use a pediatric pulse oximeter designed specifically for tiny infant fingers.
examples.zh: 居家到府訪視護理師隨身攜帶專為嬰幼兒纖細小手指量身打造的超敏小兒專用脈搏血氧儀。

words.definition: 藍牙智慧手臂式電子血壓計

examples.en: An automated digital sphygmomanometer logs morning and evening blood pressure directly into health apps.
examples.zh: 自動化藍牙電子血壓計（Sphygmomanometer）每天早晚將量測數據無縫同步上傳至個人健保雲端紀錄中。

examples.en: The veteran family physician still prefers using a classic mercury sphygmomanometer and stethoscope for precise readings.
examples.zh: 這位資歷深厚的家庭醫學科老醫師，在門診時依然最信賴傳統水銀式血壓計搭配聽診器聽取柯氏音的精準數據。

examples.en: Properly calibrating your home sphygmomanometer once a year ensures reliable tracking of hypertension.
examples.zh: 每年定期將家中的電子血壓計送回原廠或社區藥局進行標準壓力校正，是確保高血壓日常精準監控的關鍵。

words.definition: 慢病病患定時按時服藥遵從性

examples.en: Smart pillboxes with flashing alarms improve patient medication compliance, preventing blood pressure spikes.
examples.zh: 具備定時聲光提醒的智慧藥盒大幅提升了慢性病患的「服藥遵從性」（Compliance），防止血壓忽高忽低。

examples.en: The semiconductor corporation underwent an exhaustive audit to ensure full regulatory environmental compliance.
examples.zh: 該大型半導體晶圓廠主動接受各項嚴苛的環評查核，確保全廠廢水排放與廢氣處理百分之百符合法規遵循標準。

examples.en: Patient compliance with daily physical therapy exercises directly determines the success of knee replacement surgery.
examples.zh: 病患在人工全膝關節置換術後能否持之以恆嚴格配合每日下肢肌力復健操，直接決定了術後行走功能的恢復成效。

words.definition: 健保雲端電子處方箋；處方藥

examples.en: Doctors issue paperless electronic prescriptions that patients can redeem at any neighborhood pharmacy.
examples.zh: 主治醫師開立無紙化雲端電子處方箋（Prescription），民眾持手機條碼即可在全台健保特約藥局領藥。

examples.en: Antibiotics require a certified physician's prescription to prevent the dangerous spread of drug-resistant superbugs.
examples.zh: 購買各類後線抗生素藥品依法必須由合格執業醫師開立正式處方，以全面防範抗藥性超級細菌的致命蔓延。

examples.en: Walking thirty minutes every morning in a green park was the doctor's simple prescription for reducing stress.
examples.zh: 每天清晨在草木扶疏的公園快走三十分鐘，是這名心臟科名醫為這位焦慮高壓上班族開立的最有效減壓良方。

words.definition: 社區健保特約健保藥局；藥房

examples.en: Community pharmacies offer professional chronic disease medication counseling and home delivery services.
examples.zh: 街頭巷尾的健保特約社區藥局（Pharmacy），提供長輩專業的慢性病連續處方箋用藥指導與送藥到府服務。

examples.en: The hospital pharmacy employs automated robotic dispensers to pack customized patient pills with zero error.
examples.zh: 醫學中心中央藥局全面導入全自動智慧調劑分包機器人，以百分之百零失誤率精準分裝住院病患的每日口服藥。

examples.en: She earned a doctorate in clinical pharmacy before joining the intensive care unit pharmacology team.
examples.zh: 在取得臨床藥學博士學位並通過國家高考後，她正式加入加護病房重症團隊擔任重症專科臨床藥師。

words.definition: 健保雲端跨科重複用藥與交互作用攔截

examples.en: Automated cloud databases check for dangerous drug-drug interactions before doctors sign new prescriptions.
examples.zh: 健保署醫療雲端查詢系統在醫師開藥前，自動比對跨院重複用藥並攔截致命的藥物不良交互作用（Interaction）。

examples.en: Regular social interaction with neighbors and family members shields aging adults from depression and dementia.
examples.zh: 鼓勵高齡銀髮長輩保持規律的鄰里互動與親友聚會交誼，能為大腦構築一道防禦老年憂鬱與失智症的天然防火牆。

examples.en: The mobile game thrives on real-time multiplayer interaction, drawing millions of global players together.
examples.zh: 這款連線手遊以精彩的即時跨國組隊社交互動為核心玩法，吸引了全球數百萬名熱血玩家在線競技。

words.definition: 藥物過敏史雲端警示；過敏

examples.en: Severe penicillin drug allergies are permanently highlighted on the electronic health record banner.
examples.zh: 對特定抗生素盤尼西林過敏的嚴重藥物過敏史（Allergy），會在跨院電子病歷系統首頁亮起醒目的紅色警示。

examples.en: Millions of people suffer from seasonal pollen allergies, experiencing runny noses and itchy eyes every spring.
examples.zh: 每逢春暖花開時節，數以百萬計的民眾飽受花粉過敏症所苦，面臨噴嚏連連、流鼻水與眼睛奇癢難耐的困擾。

examples.en: The restaurant kitchen takes peanut allergies seriously, preparing anaphylaxis-safe meals in dedicated sanitized areas.
examples.zh: 飯店主廚嚴格正視花生引發的急性過敏性休克風險，在獨立專屬料理工作台上為過敏體質貴賓精心烹調無過敏原餐點。

words.definition: 病患個人隱私與電子病歷資安防護

examples.en: Strict hospital data encryption safeguards patient medical privacy and confidential diagnostic records.
examples.zh: 醫院資訊中心建置嚴密的醫療級資料加密防護，滴水不漏捍衛全體就醫病患的個人病歷隱私（Privacy）。

examples.en: Installing thick blackout curtains on street-facing windows ensures complete evening household privacy.
examples.zh: 在正對熱鬧街道的臥室窗戶上安裝遮光率百分之百的厚實隔音窗簾，為全家人營造出完全不被打擾的居家隱私。

examples.en: Consumer privacy regulations grant individuals the legal right to request complete deletion of their personal profiles.
examples.zh: 歐盟個人資料保護規則嚴格賦予所有公民神聖的法定權利，能依法要求任何網路平台徹底刪除其所有個人數位足跡。

words.definition: FHIR 國際醫療資料交換格式互通性

examples.en: Adopting the FHIR standard ensures seamless data interoperability between local clinics and medical centers.
examples.zh: 全面導入 FHIR 國際醫療標準格式，實現了基層診所與醫學中心之間電子病歷互通無阻的跨院互通性。

examples.en: Cloud software platforms prioritize cross-platform interoperability so mobile and desktop users share files seamlessly.
examples.zh: 當代主流雲端協作軟體平台將跨平台相容互通性列為最高準則，確保手機端與桌機端用戶能無縫即時共享檔案。

examples.en: Defense alliances establish joint hardware interoperability standards to ensure ammunition fits allied weaponry.
examples.zh: 北約軍事防衛同盟制定了嚴格的聯合後勤硬體互通標準，確保盟軍各國部隊的各口徑砲彈與步槍彈藥完全通用。

words.definition: 跨院共享之電子健康病歷 (EHR)

examples.en: Integrated Electronic Health Records (EHR) eliminate redundant blood tests across different clinics.
examples.zh: 跨院整合的電子健康病歷（EHR）能讓轉診醫師一目了然過往檢查報告，免去病患重複抽血之苦。

examples.en: The Olympic sprinter shattered the 100-meter world record by crossing the finish line in 9.58 seconds.
examples.zh: 這位傳奇牙買加短跑名將以九秒五八的驚人神速率先衝過終點線，一舉粉碎打破了塵封已久的一百公尺世界紀錄。

examples.en: Vinyl record collectors spend weekends scouring vintage music shops for rare original jazz pressings.
examples.zh: 黑膠唱片發燒收藏家每逢週末便流連於老街二手黑膠唱片行，興奮尋寶發掘早已絕版的初版經典爵士名盤。

words.definition: 數位全玻片病理切片影像；病理學

examples.en: Digital pathology scanners digitize glass tissue slides into gigapixel images for expert remote second opinions.
examples.zh: 數位全玻片病理掃描儀將實體組織切片轉化為超高解析度巨幅數位影像，方便跨國頂尖病理專家遠距會診。

examples.en: The surgical biopsy specimen was rushed to the pathology laboratory for urgent frozen section analysis.
examples.zh: 開刀房手術中取出的腫瘤活體切片檢體，被第一時間火速專人送往解剖病理科實驗室執行緊急冰凍切片化驗。

examples.en: Forensic pathology autopsies establish the precise biological cause of death in unexplained homicides.
examples.zh: 刑事法醫病理學家透過嚴謹細緻的屍體解剖法醫解剖，為離奇懸案抽絲剝繭判定確切的直接生理死亡原因。

words.definition: 次世代基因定序癌症精準基因檢測

examples.en: Comprehensive genomic profiling pinpoints specific oncogenic driver mutations to select ideal targeted drugs.
examples.zh: 透過次世代癌症全基因體檢測（Genomic Profiling），能精準鎖定致癌基因靶點突變以挑選最適標靶藥。

examples.en: Criminal psychological profiling helps detectives anticipate the serial offender's next move.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的刑事犯罪心理畫像專家（Profiling）深入剖析犯案手法，協助專案小組準確預判連環罪犯的下一步動向。

examples.en: Civil liberties groups oppose algorithmic profiling that disproportionately flags minority citizens for surveillance.
examples.zh: 人權團體強烈反對任何帶有人工智慧演算法偏見的犯罪風險側寫系統，以杜絕無差別對特定弱勢族群進行大規模監控。

words.definition: 臨床決策輔助警示系統 (CDSS)；決定

examples.en: Clinical Decision Support Systems (CDSS) cross-reference patient lab trends to suggest antibiotic adjustments.
examples.zh: 臨床決策輔助系統（CDSS）即時比對病患血液發炎指數趨勢，主動向主治醫師提出最適抗生素劑量調整建議。

examples.en: After months of soul-searching, she made the courageous decision to resign and pursue her startup dream.
examples.zh: 歷經數月的深思熟慮與內心掙扎，她終於鼓起莫大勇氣做出了人生重大決定：辭去高薪外商主管職位投入創業夢想。

examples.en: The referee's controversial penalty kick decision in the final minute sparked intense outrage in the stadium.
examples.zh: 主裁判在終場補時最後一分鐘所做出的極具爭議的十二碼十二碼罰球判決決定，引爆了全場球迷震耳欲聾的抗議怒吼。

words.definition: 智慧加護病房 (Smart ICU) 的；密集的

examples.en: Smart intensive care units use predictive algorithms to anticipate respiratory distress hours before it occurs.
examples.zh: 智慧加護病房（Smart ICU）配備預測演算法，能在重症病患發生急性呼吸衰竭的數小時前即刻發出預警。

examples.en: The candidate underwent three weeks of intensive media training before the televised presidential debate.
examples.zh: 總統候選人在出席舉國矚目的電視直播辯論會前夕，接受了為期三週全天候高強度的媒體應對密集特訓。

examples.en: Intensive organic agriculture utilizes crop rotation and composting to achieve high yields on small parcels.
examples.zh: 精緻有機集約農業巧妙結合間作輪作與天然落葉堆肥，在有限的微型農地耕作面積上創造出令人驚豔的極高畝產。

words.definition: 全身性重症致命敗血症

examples.en: Early sepsis detection algorithms alert nurses to rising lactic acid levels, saving critically ill patients.
examples.zh: 敗血症（Sepsis）早期預警演算法即時監控血液乳酸與發炎指數，在黃金搶救時間內挽救寶貴生命。

examples.en: Untreated kidney infections can rapidly escalate into life-threatening bacterial bloodstream sepsis.
examples.zh: 急性腎盂腎炎若延誤治療未及時控制，細菌極易侵入血液引發全身性發炎，迅速惡化為隨時致命的敗血性休克。

examples.en: Immediate administration of broad-spectrum intravenous antibiotics is critical within the first hour of sepsis onset.
examples.zh: 在診斷懷疑敗血症發作的「黃金一小時」內，立即透過靜脈點滴輸注廣效性抗生素是挽救生命的最核心醫療作為。

words.definition: 手術全身麻醉深度監測；麻醉

examples.en: Continuous brain wave monitoring ensures the patient remains in safe, deep anesthesia throughout surgery.
examples.zh: 麻醉專科醫師全程透過腦電波深度監控儀，確保病患在整場大手術中維持絕對安全且安睡無痛的麻醉狀態。

examples.en: The dentist applied local anesthesia to numb the upper gum before performing the root canal procedure.
examples.zh: 牙醫在展開顯微根管治療前，先在上顎牙齦周圍進行局部麻醉注射，使神經完全麻木以確保療程全程無痛。

examples.en: Fasting for eight hours prior to surgery prevents pulmonary aspiration during general anesthesia induction.
examples.zh: 術前嚴格恪守空腹禁食八小時規範，是防止全身麻醉誘導插管時因胃內容物嘔吐反流引發致命吸入性肺炎的關鍵。

words.definition: 外骨骼機器人中風行走復健

examples.en: Robotic exoskeleton gait trainers guide stroke survivors through repetitive walking rehabilitation exercises.
examples.zh: 穿戴式外骨骼機器人步態訓練機，能引導中風偏癱長輩進行高強度、安全規律的下肢行走復健（Rehabilitation）。

examples.en: After knee reconstruction surgery, the athlete spent six months in rigorous physical rehabilitation.
examples.zh: 在順利完成前十字韌帶重建手術後，這位職業足球員在專業體能訓練中心度過了整整半年高強度的運動復健。

examples.en: The correctional system emphasizes prisoner vocational education and social rehabilitation rather than mere punishment.
examples.zh: 現代進步的監獄矯正體系更側重於受刑人的技職教育培訓與心理輔導，期盼協助其重返社會並達成真正的更生復健。

words.definition: 醫療復健動力外骨骼機器人

examples.en: Motorized robotic exoskeletons provide powered hip and knee support, enabling paralyzed patients to stand.
examples.zh: 醫療級動力外骨骼機器人（Exoskeleton）提供強勁的髖膝關節動力支撐，讓下半身癱瘓患者重新站立昂首前行。

examples.en: In biology, arthropods such as crabs and beetles protect their bodies with a hard chitinous outer exoskeleton.
examples.zh: 在無脊椎動物學中，螃蟹、龍蝦與甲蟲等節肢動物，全身披覆著一層由幾丁質構成的堅硬外骨骼以保護柔軟臟器。

examples.en: Factory workers wear passive shoulder exoskeletons that reduce strain when performing repetitive overhead tasks.
examples.zh: 汽車組裝廠產線工人配戴被動式肩關節機械外骨骼支架，大幅減輕長時間仰頭抬臂鎖螺絲對肩頸肌肉造成的疲勞傷害。

words.definition: 仿生智慧電子義肢；假體

examples.en: Mind-controlled myoelectric bionic prostheses translate arm muscle signals into precise finger motions.
examples.zh: 結合肌電訊號傳導的智慧仿生電子義肢（Prosthesis），能精準讀取殘肢肌肉微電壓以靈巧控制各指關節。

examples.en: Carbon-fiber sprinting blade prostheses allow Paralympic athletes to run at near-Olympic track speeds.
examples.zh: 採用高彈性航太碳纖維打造的獵豹刀鋒跑步義肢，讓身障帕運田徑國手在百米跑道上奔馳出媲美奧運健兒的神速。

examples.en: The orthotic technician custom-fitted a lightweight silicone leg prosthesis for the active teenager.
examples.zh: 義肢輔具技術師為這位熱愛戶外運動的青少年截肢患者，客製化精準翻模取型並調整輕量化矽膠下肢義肢。

words.definition: 3D 列印生物相容性純鈦骨釘人工關節植入物

examples.en: 3D-printed porous titanium bone implants fuse seamlessly with living human bone within months.
examples.zh: 採用 3D 列印客製化多孔純鈦人體植入物（Implant），能在數月內與病患原生自體骨骼完美結合為一體。

examples.en: Thousands of patients replace deteriorated joints with artificial ceramic hip implants each year.
examples.zh: 每年全台灣有上萬名受重度退化性關節炎折磨的長輩，透過置換高耐磨陶瓷人工全髖關節植入物重獲健步如飛的生機。

examples.en: The cardiac surgeon successfully placed a miniature permanent pacemaker implant inside the patient's chest.
examples.zh: 心臟外科權威主治醫師在患者左側胸壁皮下微創切口，順利植入一顆硬幣大小的超微型永久心臟節律器植入物。

words.definition: 院內感染管制洗手衛生規範

examples.en: Rigorous hand hygiene protocols and UV sterilization robots eliminate hospital-acquired infections.
examples.zh: 落實嚴格的「內外夾弓大立腕」洗手衛生規範（Hygiene）搭配紫外線消毒機器人，徹底阻斷院內交叉感染。

examples.en: Proper dental hygiene requires brushing twice daily, cleaning with floss, and scheduling routine cleanings.
examples.zh: 良好的口腔牙齒個人衛生習慣，在於每天早晚確實刷牙、搭配牙線清除齒縫殘渣，並每半年定期洗牙檢查。

examples.en: Food safety inspectors shut down the restaurant kitchen due to shocking failures in basic food preparation hygiene.
examples.zh: 衛生局食品藥物管理稽查大隊在突擊檢查中，發現該熱門餐廳後廚存在嚴重的食材保鮮與環境衛生違規，當場勒令停業。

words.definition: 預防醫學早篩早治的；預防性的

examples.en: Preventive medicine emphasizes annual health screenings, balanced nutrition, and regular aerobic exercise.
examples.zh: 現代「預防醫學」（Preventive Medicine）強調定期成人健檢、均衡原型飲食與規律運動，防患於未然。

examples.en: Regular vehicle maintenance, such as oil changes and tire rotations, serves as effective preventive care.
examples.zh: 養成每半年定期進廠更換機油、檢查煞車皮與輪胎對調的愛車保養習慣，是最行之有效的預防性防範保養作為。

examples.en: The police took preventive security measures, setting up checkpoints around the international summit venue.
examples.zh: 國安特勤單位在國際高峰會會場周邊數公里提前採取嚴密的預防性維安措施，層層設立防暴路障與臨檢崗哨。

words.definition: 身心靈全面全人健康的

examples.en: Holistic medicine addresses emotional stress, sleep quality, and lifestyle alongside physical medical symptoms.
examples.zh: 「全人醫療」（Holistic Medicine）不僅醫治器官肉體病痛，更同理撫慰病患的情緒壓力與生活作息。

examples.en: Educators advocate a holistic pedagogy that values artistic creativity and empathy as highly as test scores.
examples.zh: 進步的教育改革家全力倡導身心均衡發展的全人教育理念，將藝術審美創造力與同理心視為與學術考試同等重要的維度。

examples.en: Urban rejuvenation requires a holistic approach that integrates green spaces, public transit, and affordable housing.
examples.zh: 老舊市中心老城區的活化再生，必須採取統籌兼顧的全方位整體方針，將公園綠地、大眾捷運與青年社會住宅深度融合。

words.definition: 仁心仁術視病猶親的；富同情心的

examples.en: True medical excellence combines cutting-edge AI technology with warm, compassionate bedside care.
examples.zh: 醫學殿堂的最高境界，在於將最頂尖的 AI 科技與視病猶親、充滿溫暖同理心（Compassionate）的床邊關懷完美結合。

examples.en: The compassionate hospice nurse held the dying patient's hand gently, offering quiet comfort during his final hours.
examples.zh: 充滿慈悲大愛的安寧病房護理師，溫柔握著走到生命終點臨終長輩乾枯的雙手，在最後時刻給予最平靜安詳的撫慰。

examples.en: Compassionate leaders listen actively to employee struggles and support their mental health during crises.
examples.zh: 具備仁愛同理心的卓越企業領袖，始終耐心傾聽同仁在工作與生活中的真實困境，並在家庭重大變故時給予最堅定的支持。

words.definition: 第一線白衣天使與醫護無私奉獻

examples.en: We express our deepest gratitude for the tireless dedication of frontline nurses and healthcare heroes.
examples.zh: 我們由衷向日夜堅守第一線、守護全民健康福祉的白衣天使與全體醫護人員的無私奉獻（Dedication）致敬。

examples.en: Reaching the pinnacle of Olympic gymnastics requires decades of unwavering daily dedication and sacrifice.
examples.zh: 想要登上四年一度奧運體操頒獎台的最頂峰，需要數十年如一日、風雨無阻且拋開所有娛樂的日常專注投入與奉獻。

examples.en: The university dedicated a new cancer research library in honor of the late professor's lifelong scholarly dedication.
examples.zh: 該國立大學隆重落成了一座尖端癌症醫學研究圖書館，深情致敬已故講座教授一生奉獻給醫學教育的崇高學術熱忱。
